Production Glossary · 01/50 · planning

Production brief

Definition

Production brief is the agreed document that connects objectives, audience, scope, constraints, deliverables and approvals. In a controlled workflow, its owner, version and acceptance evidence should be recorded.

Why it matters

This concept helps production teams align planning decisions, handoffs and verification without relying on unstated assumptions.

Related terms

  • Delivery specification
  • Deliverable manifest
